module_summary: AXI4 full slave bridging to NS simplified single-beat slaves: skid-buffered write/read burst trackers step addresses, decode slave selects, and return responses through backpressure FIFOs with exclusive-access tracking.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write address request into the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW skid buffer ready back to upstream master.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Upstream write burst start address, buffered then decoded to a slave.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid; directly gates downstream M_AXI_AWVALID per beat.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready, equal to write_request burst-active flag.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data passed straight through to the shared M_AXI_WDATA.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when the B FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code popped from the B response FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read burst request captured into ar* registers.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready when no burst remains and read FIFO not full.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Upstream read burst start address.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid when the read return FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned upstream from the read return FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave write strobe from wdecode, gated by WVALID and lock.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Shared downstream write address driven from write_addr.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Shared downstream write data, copy of S_AXI_WDATA.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave write responses indexed by write_bindex into write_resp.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave read strobe from rdecode when issue_read.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated per-slave read data, muxed by last_read_index.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave read responses used to form read_resp.

anchors.name: awskid_valid
anchors.why: AW skid buffer output valid starting a new write burst.

anchors.name: write_awskidready
anchors.why: Accepts next AW request at burst end when B FIFO not full.

anchors.name: write_addr
anchors.why: Current write beat address, loaded from AW and stepped by axi_addr each beat.

anchors.name: write_request
anchors.why: Write burst active; drives WREADY and gates M_AXI_AWVALID until WLAST.

anchors.name: wdecode
anchors.why: One-hot write slave select (plus no-slave bit) held for the whole burst.

anchors.name: last_wdecode
anchors.why: Latches decoder output for remaining burst beats.

anchors.name: write_bindex
anchors.why: Registered slave index selecting which M_AXI_BRESP to check.

anchors.name: write_resp
anchors.why: Sticky accumulated burst write response (DECERR/SLVERR/EXOKAY) pushed into B FIFO.

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Outstanding write burst count guarding B FIFO overflow.

anchors.name: bfull
anchors.why: Write pseudo-FIFO full; blocks accepting new AW requests.

anchors.name: araddr
anchors.why: Current read beat address, captured from AR and stepped per issued read.

anchors.name: rlen
anchors.why: Remaining read beats; gates ARREADY and ends arvalid.

anchors.name: arvalid
anchors.why: Read burst in progress; qualifies read_rvalid pipeline start.

anchors.name: issue_read
anchors.why: Issues a downstream read beat whenever the read FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: rdecode
anchors.why: One-hot read slave select driving M_AXI_ARVALID and read index.

anchors.name: last_rdecode
anchors.why: Holds read decoder output while decoder is not valid.

anchors.name: last_read_index
anchors.why: Selects which slave's RDATA/RRESP is captured on return.

anchors.name: read_rdata
anchors.why: Registered selected slave read data pushed into read FIFO.

anchors.name: read_resp
anchors.why: Registered read response (DECERR/SLVERR/EXOKAY/OKAY).

anchors.name: read_rvalid
anchors.why: Implied slave RVALID one cycle after an issued read.

anchors.name: read_result
anchors.why: Writes the read result into the return FIFO.

anchors.name: read_rvlast
anchors.why: Locally generated RLAST for the beat when rlen reaches zero.

anchors.name: read_full
anchors.why: Read pseudo-FIFO full; blocks issue_read and ARREADY.

anchors.name: read_count
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats count guarding read FIFO overflow.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.r_lock_valid
anchors.why: Exclusive read reservation valid, cleared by overlapping writes.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.r_locked_burst
anchors.why: Exclusive write matches reservation; allows locked write and EXOKAY.

anchors.name: EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS.lock_addr
anchors.why: Reserved exclusive-access address compared against writes.

anchors.name: locked_write
anchors.why: Current write burst is exclusive; blocks downstream writes without reservation.

anchors.name: read_rvlock
anchors.why: Read beat is exclusive with valid lock; selects EXOKAY response.

groups.name: Write address skid and capture
groups.description: AW skid buffer, captured burst parameters and next write address generator.

groups.name: Write burst control
groups.description: Tracks write beats, drives WREADY and per-slave AWVALID/WVALID.

groups.name: Write slave decode
groups.description: Address decoder producing one-hot write slave select and index.

groups.name: Write response path
groups.description: Accumulates burst response and queues it in B FIFO with occupancy guard.

groups.name: Read burst control
groups.description: Captures AR burst, steps address, counts beats and issues per-slave reads.

groups.name: Read slave decode
groups.description: Decodes read address to slave select and index for return mux.

groups.name: Read return path
groups.description: Muxes slave read data/response and queues it in read FIFO with occupancy guard.

groups.name: Exclusive access monitor
groups.description: Tracks exclusive read reservation and validates exclusive writes.
